name: tests-75pct-jd-diff-path-transformation-plans
instr:
jd cannot currently relocate existing diffs safely across its formats and interfaces.

Return an independent complete Diff and deterministic report in original hunk order, or a TransformError naming the rule, source, destination, and cause with no partial results. Later input path mutations must not affect the Diff. Distinguish object keys, list indexes, set identities, and multiset identities. Relocate list positions and strict before-and-after context together in plan order.

Preserve native jd typed collection markers, metadata, context, patch-equivalent ordering, and meaning. Preserve JSON Patch pointer escaping and related operations, rejecting ambiguous paths. Rebuild compatible JSON Merge Patch object ancestry and reject conflicts atomically. Renderers must reject unrepresentable paths. Unmatched plans must not change reading, rendering, or patching.

Keep legacy and v2 results aligned for representable legacy paths without extending legacy collection semantics. Active and compatibility CLIs must transform before translation or patching, preserve established streams, destinations, and status behavior, and report one structured failure without output. Browser reconciliation must validate plan text, use v2 semantics for transformed translations and patches, and retain its last successful result after failure. Library, CLI, and browser entry points must agree on destinations, atomic failures, format limits, and behavior when no plan is supplied.

Package github.com/joseph
